title: What Is AIVideosUGC? Company Facts for Sellers | AIVideosUGC
description: What AIVideosUGC makes from your product photos, how credits and plans work, what the tools don't do, and what you finish yourself after download.
lead: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into store images and short AI video ads in minutes, with no studio or casting. Here is exactly what it does, what it costs and what you finish yourself.

faq.a: An online tool that turns a product photo or a product page link into short video ads and store-ready product images for online stores.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. The credit cost of each video or photo is shown before it starts, and failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC add spoken narration or music?
faq.a: Product clips come without voiceover, music or captions, so add those in your editor after download. AI actor clips are different: the actor speaks the one line you write, with mouth movement that follows the words.

faq.q: What video settings can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds and 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9, so the same product photo can produce a vertical ad, a square listing video or a wide banner.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Videos use 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10 seconds, 60 for 15 seconds and 120 for 30 seconds. The exact cost is always on screen before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos and videos are cleared for commercial use and have no watermark, so you can run them on marketplaces, social platforms and your own store, subject to each platform's rules.
